result.evidence: The hypothesis describes a traffic signal control system that adjusts green time based on queue length measurements at intersections. This is a completely different domain from the source document, which describes how Physarum polycephalum (slime mold) adapts its tubular network through protoplasmic streaming and feedback mechanisms. While both systems involve self-organization and feedback loops, the specific mechanisms, entities (traffic signals vs. cytoplasmic tubes), and application domains (traffic engineering vs. biological organisms) are fundamentally different. The hypothesis requires transferring the concept of self-optimizing networks through local feedback to an entirely new domain not present in the source text.
